Pricing

Last updated 14 September 2026 · Effective 14 September 2026

The short version. The whole game is free to play right here, in your browser, right now. There is one paid product in the plan: a one-time $4.99 USD unlock for the mobile edition. No subscription, no advertising, no coins for sale.

1. Free edition — this website

Price: $0. Forever. Everything on devildictionary.com is playable without paying:

  • All 100 entries, across all four stages.
  • Stage II · The Judgment, where you must pick the true definition from three plausible ones.
  • Synthesised sound effects, Devil Coins, and progress saved between visits.
  • No account. No email address. No advertising. No tracking. Nothing is uploaded.

It runs in any modern browser on a phone, tablet or desktop, and there is also a single-file offline edition you can download once and keep forever — it works with no internet connection at all.

Play it free

2. Mobile edition coming soon

An iOS edition built for the App Store is in preparation. It follows the same structure, split like this:

  • Free: the first 30 entries, including the introduction of Stage II · The Judgment. Enough to decide whether the book deserves a place on your phone.
  • Complete Edition — $4.99 USD, one time: unlocks the remaining 70 entries, including Stage III · The Accomplice and Stage IV · The Author in full.

This price is not yet live, because the app is not yet released. If it changes before launch, anyone who has already bought it keeps permanent access at the price they paid.

4. What you will never be charged for

  • No subscriptions. Nothing renews, so nothing needs cancelling.
  • No advertising. No ad SDKs, no video placements, no interrupts.
  • No consumables. No energy, no extra moves, no pay-to-win. The unlock buys content, never advantage.
  • No purchasable coins. Devil Coins are a trophy for completing words. They have no monetary value and cannot be bought at any price.
  • No paywall mid-puzzle. Nothing you are in the middle of solving is ever locked.

5. Price, currency and tax

Prices are stated in US dollars. When you buy through the App Store, Apple displays the final amount in your local currency — including any applicable sales tax or VAT — before you confirm anything. Nothing is charged until you confirm.

If the price ever changes, it applies only to new purchases. Existing unlocks are honoured indefinitely.

6. Questions

Is there a free trial?

Effectively yes. In the mobile edition the first 30 entries are free, so you can play a substantial part of the game before deciding. On the web, all of it is free.

I have already paid. Do I need to pay again on a new device?

No. The unlock is tied to your Apple ID. Use Restore Purchases and it comes back at no cost.

Do you offer refunds?

Yes, subject to the app store’s own process. See the refund policy.

Are my children safe in here?

The definitions are satirical and aimed at adults, but there is no advertising, no user-generated content, no chat, and no collection of personal data. See the privacy policy.
